svg.title: Deployment: where each part runs, and what separates it
svg.desc: Deployment and trust-boundary diagram of Aegis Sentinel: the desktop app and CLI on one computer, the Docker deployment with its four containers, and the external services each mode can reach.

g.text: Mode 1 Desktop app and CLI: one computer, one OS user
Everything below runs as the signed-in user, with that user's files, network and keys.
Mode 2 Docker deployment: one host, four containers (docker-compose.yml)
Distinct users, read-only root file systems, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, memory, CPU and process limits.
Chips: the modes that reach each one.
process separation, not a security boundary
reached from the desktop mode (D) or the Docker mode (K)
Configuration and keys from the OS keyring or .env. Reads files to walk,
hash and quarantine them; never parses them.
encrypted files; key in the keystore (mode 0600)
a trip runs containment on the user's processes
The whole detection pipeline. Time limit SCAN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS;
memory limit: RLIMIT_AS (Linux), Job Object (Windows), RSS watchdog
They receive the full configuration, API keys included.
Helper programs started by a worker
7-Zip or unar, Tesseract, poppler, box-js. Stopped with their worker; one
that detached before discovery can survive (L-E5).
uid 10001; network_mode none: no interface but loopback.
Secrets: api_token and intel_token only. tmpfs /tmp; volumes
analysis-state (reports, logs, outbox) and content (rules, read-only).
time and memory limits; no network, no API keys
--update-rules; network_mode none; writes the content volume that
api-socket and intel-socket carry Unix sockets between containers;
analysis-state, content and intel-state hold data; secrets are files under
Not in this mode: webhooks, JSON Lines, S3 uploads, automatic quarantine and --scan-imap. The analysis side has no network and intel offers no IMAP
operation; API results reach e-mail only, through intel.
hash look-ups; uploads only if switched on
document text sent for an opinion
your own server in a separately isolated
environment; files are detonated there, never here
intel reaches the services marked K over its egress
network; the analysis container cannot reach any
Security boundaries: the containers, and the
separate CAPE environment. Worker processes are
not one: on a desktop they share the user's access;
in Docker they share uid 10001 with the API server.
Deployment: where each part runs, and what separates it
Two execution modes and the boundaries between their parts. Branch review/production-hardening, commit e012d3f.
